news.headline: Lake Street Cuts ClearPoint Neuro Price Target to $11 from $15 After Q2 Miss
news.summary: Lake Street lowered its price target on ClearPoint Neuro to $11 from $15 while maintaining a Buy rating, citing a revenue-forecast revision and market-wide multiple compression following the Q2 miss. The firm said its three primary growth drivers 'remain in play' and does not expect the cut to change ClearPoint's long-term potential, only the pace of investment.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: Q2 revenue of $10.9 million (+18% YoY) missed the roughly $12.7 million consensus as operating expenses rose 51% to $17.0 million, widening the net loss to $11.3 million and leaving cash at $29.4 million; the company reaffirmed 2026 revenue guidance of $48-52 million and unveiled a five-pillar strategy targeting $500 million in long-term annual revenue, highlighting its new Torrey Pines CAL laboratory now in operation. Shares fell roughly 15-20% in after-hours trading to around $13.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro congratulated drug-delivery partner Aspen Neuroscience after its autologous dopaminergic neuron cell-replacement therapy sasineprocel (ANPD001) received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation, giving Aspen priority FDA interactions and a potential accelerated-approval pathway for a therapy delivered via ClearPoint's platform.

news.headline: BlackRock Discloses 7.1% Passive Stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: An amended Schedule 13G filing showed BlackRock now holds about 2.12 million CLPT shares (7.1% of shares outstanding) as a passive institutional investor, indicating continued index/passive-fund accumulation in the stock.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Shares Jump on News That Partner uniQure Reaches FDA Alignment on AMT-130 Accelerated-Approval Path
news.summary: ClearPoint shares surged roughly 32% after partner uniQure said the FDA agreed its 3-year Phase 1/2 AMT-130 Huntington's disease data could support an accelerated-approval BLA, targeted for a Q3 2026 submission; AMT-130 is delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, directly tying its commercial prospects to the filing.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure targets a Q3 2026 BLA filing for Huntington's disease gene therapy AMT-130, delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula; a positive filing/outcome would validate the platform commercially.

catalysts.label: Biologics & Drug Delivery segment return to growth
catalysts.detail: Company guidance expects the segment (down about 15% YoY in Q2) to return to growth in Q3 2026 as new CAL (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) preclinical/GLP services revenue from the newly operational Torrey Pines facility ramps.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results expected roughly mid-November 2026 based on historical reporting cadence; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Oberland Capital financing option
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint retains the option (with Oberland Capital) to draw up to an additional $75M in tranches ($25M company option, $50M joint option) under its note financing facility before year-end 2026, plus a $1.5M equity participation right.

catalysts.label: Full-year revenue guidance
catalysts.detail: Company reaffirmed 2026 revenue guidance of $48.0-52.0 million despite the Q2 miss.

catalysts.label: Potential commercial approvals among 60+ biopharma partners
catalysts.detail: Management points to several partnered cell/gene therapy programs (including uniQure and Aspen Neuroscience) under FDA expedited review with a possible path to commercial approval as early as 2027, which would activate ClearPoint's fifth ('commercial') growth pillar.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro is still digesting a rough Q2 2026 print (Aug 3): revenue of $10.9M missed consensus by roughly 14%, opex jumped over 50%, cash fell to $29.4M, and shares dropped sharply toward the low-teens, prompting Lake Street to trim its target to $11 (from $15) while keeping a Buy rating. Underlying partner momentum stayed intact even as the stock sold off -- Aspen Neuroscience won FDA RMAT designation (July 31) for a therapy delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow system, and BlackRock's passive stake rose to 7.1% (July 27) -- but shares remain well below their 52-week high near $30 as investors weigh cash burn against management's ambitious $500M long-term revenue target. The next major swing factor is partner uniQure's targeted Q3 2026 BLA filing for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, which would validate ClearPoint's delivery platform commercially well ahead of its own 2027 commercial pillar.
